name: hadron
description: Hadron is more than a modern and customizable Grav theme and skeleton. On the one hand, it is optimized for beginners to quickly create a simple website, but on the other hand, it is also suitable for professionals who want to use Hadron as a foundation for a complex website with self-developed functions.
